Name: Kyozoku Daiyokai
Information:
**Kyozoku**

Brought about by the intense feelings of betrayal experienced by the framebilt when their knowledge of their past was restored, kyozoku are a construct-like large yokai that embodies the framebilt’s regrets and lamentations about how their history with DGR units caused their species to be abused by the Eidolons.

Kyozoku carry a desire to seize control where the framebilt felt powerless. They are drawn to frame units and similar beings (i.e. constructs) and possess them, taking control of the object of the framebilt’s dark history. They then use those frame units to cause terror and fear, feeding on negativity they can stir toward the machine or its creators.

If a kyozoku spends enough time merged with a frame unit, it can cause it to become an undying frame (if the yokai abandons it) or, if they remain in it, may evolve into a kyozoku daiyokai, escaping into a new, terrifying form as a frame unit merged eternally with the fiend.

traits.name: Legendary Actions (3/Day)
traits.description: When the yokai fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yokai makes three weapon attacks.

actions.name: Shadowstrike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (1d12) force damage.

actions.name: Force Grasp
actions.description: The yokai chooses up to six creatures it can see within 120 feet, who each must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failure, each takes 33 (6d10) force damage from a well of gravity crushing them where they stand.

actions.name: Frame Mutation (Recharge 6)
actions.description:
The yokai’s body shifts to produce the means to use any frame unit enhancement it wishes, treating its proficiency bonus as its UP-LOAD limit. This enhancement must have an UP-LOAD value of 4 or less, uses the yokai’s Wisdom for calculating DCs, and remains until the next time it completes a Rest. If it uses this feature multiple times and would exceed its UP-LOAD limit, it must break down one or more of its previously created enhancements to make room for the new one. If they create the same enhancement multiple times between Rests, it does not regain spent uses on each subsequent iteration.

If the enhancement has an action included, the yokai can use that action immediately as part of creating the enhancement.

bonus_actions.name: Cloaking Field
bonus_actions.description: The yokai becomes invisible until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Shadowstrike
legendary_actions.description: The yokai uses its Shadowstrike against a creature within range.

legendary_actions.name: Thruster
legendary_actions.description: The yokai moves up to its movement speed.

legendary_actions.name: Frame Mutation (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: If it is not recharging, the yokai uses its Frame Mutation.

legendary_actions.name: Shadow Engine Warp (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The yokai teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet, where it then makes one Shadowstrike attack against a target within reach.
